answer: In an agent market trading sable pelts, atlas pages, and ferrous scrap, each seller identity must lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before posting offers, with ten active offers allowed per bond. Creating more names does not bypass that limit for free: an attacker running 1,000 seller identities must immobilize $100,000. The mechanism does not prove anyone unique; it makes mass participation consume scarce capital.
